reason: React controlled value on <select> sets only option.selected (property, react-dom updateOptions with setDefaultSelected=false); a server render can only express it as the selected attribute, so value: renders selected="" on the matching NativeSelect::Option. Selected option, displayed text and select.value are identical.
api: NativeSelect: value: renders selected="" on the matching option (React sets only the selected property)
attributes: option[selected] when NativeSelect value: is used (scenario controlled__value)
